title: [CTL-LIVE-CODEX-V2] Anchor result-tree evidence and bind executor/worker receipt provenance

subject.subject_note: This receipt binds the implementation commit above. The receipt file itself lands in a following commit on the same branch and does not change the bound implementation subject.

durable_result_carrier.mechanism: Base and result trees are published as two parentless evidence commits under refs/evidence/codex-v2/<carrier-id>/{base,result} and packed into a content-addressed Git bundle with a sidecar manifest naming repository, base sha, base tree, result tree, changed-path denominator, evidence commits, bundle SHA-256 and bundle byte length.
durable_result_carrier.isolation: Replay creates a bare scratch repository outside the originating repository with GIT_DIR, GIT_WORK_TREE, GIT_INDEX_FILE, GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY, GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES, GIT_COMMON_DIR and GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES stripped from the environment. No reflog or accidental object retention is relied on and no implementation branch is moved.

executor_provenance.recomputable: adapter_blob_sha256 is recomputed from the adapter that would actually execute; codex_binary_sha256 is recomputed from the recorded path when that file is present.
executor_provenance.never_persisted: auth or session values, tokens, subscription material, raw prompts, private reasoning, final model prose, terminal transcripts. A signed-in session is explicitly not treated as executable provenance.

strict_worker_result_schema.binder_consumption: compile_codex_live_acceptance.py calls check_codex_worker_result.check_result() before any acceptance logic and then replays the durable carrier. It no longer defines the worker-result shape in code and no longer reads the originating worktree.

command_contract.acceptance_binder: python3 skills/agentic-tech-lead-orchestration/scripts/compile_codex_live_acceptance.py <ACCEPTANCE_INPUT_JSON> --output <RECEIPT_JSON>   # input keys: worker_result, controller, carrier_bundle_path

self_demo.description: One real end-to-end round trip outside the test suite: scratch repository created, post-turn tree materialized through a private index, carrier published, originating repository deleted with shutil.rmtree, result tree then resolved from bundle + manifest alone and its post-turn bytes read back.

verdict_basis: offline replay resolves the exact result tree after the originating temporary worktree and object directory are deleted (self_demo and two selftests)
all planted controls turn red for their intended reason
the schema positive case validates and the acceptance binder consumes the validated result
evidence_ceiling: Deterministic mechanics only. This receipt proves durable result-carrier replay, executable provenance binding, and strict worker-result shape for the exact implementation subject named above. It does not prove a fresh signed-in Codex v2 run, controller acceptance of a live turn, Shadow readback, model quality, general runtime portability, production safety, release, or promotion. No live #464 promotion is claimed. Merge remains separate repository authority.
